title: A fully averaged poroelastic Kirchhoff plate interacting with an incompressible, viscous fluid: analysis and numerical simulation
summary: We study a new fully averaged poroelastic Kirchhoff plate model coupled with the flow of an incompressible, viscous fluid governed by the time-dependent Stokes equations. The fully averaged formulation offers several advantages over the classical Biot poroelastic plate model: both elastodynamic and pressure equations are posed on a codimension-one interface, the resulting numerical schemes are simpler to implement and computationally more efficient, and the fluid-structure coupling is more natural.
